title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Moody Theater, Austin | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Moody Theater in Austin, Texas, USA, on 9 June 2024.

It was the 12th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2024 tour. Edgar Winter did not perform at this show.

Starr had previously performed at the Moody Theater on 8 and 12 October 2014 and 31 October 2017.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’

  • ‘Yellow Submarine’

  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’

  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
